name: Nestlé Pizza Division - Little Chute WI

fieldNotes.truckGate: The north truck yard is fully enclosed by chain-link perimeter fencing. Street View (2024-10) shows a sliding/swing gate across the truck driveway off W North Ave. Two driveway openings serve the fenced yard.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small white-roofed booth-footprint structure with a vehicle beside it sits at the truck-yard driveway entrance (z21 imagery). Reads as a guard booth - flagged uncertain as Street View did not give a clean booth view.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Two distinct driveway openings onto W North Ave serve the truck yard - likely used as separate in/out gates.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Two driveway openings onto W North Ave; counted as 2 truck gates - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The fenced truck yard provides deep queue room between the W North Ave gate and the dock doors.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large drop yard on the north with ~50 trailers parked in long rows; additional trailers on the SE. dropArea 50+.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Large open paved truck yard with ample width for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~35 estimated along the building's north face where trailers back in; partly obscured - low-confidence count.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs immediately along the building's SE face with a rail siding/car present - the plant is rail-served.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Little Chute is a village within the Appleton / Fox Cities metro; the plant is embedded in dense residential fabric. Judged Urban - flagged as borderline.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly visible; flagged uncertain.
